differences.current: The provided full-screen Make preview accepted demo/demo123 and exposed the interface-management assertion tab. All six assertion types were opened and captured.
differences.resolution: Resolved the preview access blocker with a real browser session and registered screenshots for login, assertion menu, and all six assertion editors. No source code was modified.
differences.followUp: Complete per-variant event, computed-style, bounding-box, and paired visual review for every required state.
differences.decisionBasis: The provided Make preview contains its own simulated login and explicitly documents 'wrong' as the error-state password.
differences.impact: Make post-login interaction states, paired visual review, and all 66 four-source matrix items remain unverified.

differences.current: The running backend accepts superadmin/superadmin123; superadmin23 returns 401. With the accepted credential, localhost:4173 opened the X-MAN workspace and the assertion tab.
differences.resolution: Validated the real browser flow through login, workspace selection, assertion tab empty state, add menu, and status-code assertion editor. No authentication bypass or source change was used.
differences.followUp: Complete the remaining assertion variants and paired visual review after Make post-login capture.
differences.decisionBasis: Direct POST /auth/login response was 200 for superadmin123; 23 is not the password configured by the current backend.
differences.impact: Basic Vue browser flow is verified; remaining matrix states and visual pairing are still pending.

differences.current: Vue listed 响应体断言 before 响应头断言, while Make listed 响应头断言 before 响应体断言.
differences.resolution: Reordered assertionTypeOptions to 状态码、响应头、响应体、响应时间、变量、脚本, matching Make and the source interaction order.
differences.followUp: Recheck the menu after shared option changes; the 1920px browser capture confirms the new order.
differences.decisionBasis: The Make preview menu is the interaction source of truth for this order.
differences.impact: Menu navigation now reaches each assertion variant in the same order as Make.

differences.current: Vue applied a shared 14px request-body inset and its assertion panel stayed at a fixed 316px height, leaving an unbounded blank area above the response panel.
differences.resolution: Added an assertion-tab-only flex container with zero padding and allowed the assertion panel/editor to fill the available request area. Vue geometry now matches Make: list x=306,width=264 and detail x=570,width=1350, with 574px expanded and 814px collapsed heights at 1920x1080.
differences.followUp: Recheck all six assertion editors and response states after the shared container change.
differences.decisionBasis: Measured Make and Vue computed bounding boxes at the same browser viewport; the assertion region is the requested alignment scope.
differences.impact: The assertion list/editor now occupy the same content width and respond to response-panel expansion consistently.

differences.current: The Vue status-code condition select inherited Element Plus 14px/600 typography, visibly heavier than Make.
differences.resolution: Scoped the status-code condition select to the Make-referenced 12px/400 typography and verified the browser computed style.
differences.followUp: Pair the status-code typography with Design and Make screenshots in the remaining matrix review.
differences.decisionBasis: Make preview visual reference and direct computed-style measurement.
differences.impact: The condition label no longer renders with the heavier component-library default weight.

differences.current: Vue operation controls inherited the generic row-button color and spacing, making the copy and delete actions differ from Make.
differences.resolution: Scoped operation icon buttons to fixed 22px controls, blue copy color, and red delete color while retaining the fixed operation columns.
differences.followUp: Pair the response-header operation row with Design and Make screenshots in the remaining matrix review.
differences.decisionBasis: Make preview operation icons and direct bounding-box/computed-style measurement.
differences.impact: Copy/delete controls now use the same visual treatment and stable operation-column geometry.

differences.current: Vue showed extra XML and HTML format choices for XPath and the toolbar height changed when switching JSONPath/XPath.
differences.resolution: Removed the extra response-format select and fixed the body assertion toolbar at 28px for JSONPath, XPath, and Regex.
differences.followUp: Pair all response-body modes with Design and Make screenshots in the remaining matrix review.
differences.decisionBasis: Make preview body assertion toolbar contains only JSONPath/XPath/Regex controls.
differences.impact: XPath no longer exposes unreferenced XML/HTML controls or changes the editor toolbar height.

differences.current: The response-time condition select inherited heavier typography and its surrounding control geometry was not explicitly constrained to the Make layout.
differences.resolution: Applied the same 12px/400 condition typography and retained the fixed response-time field widths and table/control column rules.
differences.followUp: Pair response-time typography and dimensions with Design and Make screenshots in the remaining matrix review.
differences.decisionBasis: Make preview response-time editor and direct computed-style measurement.
differences.impact: The response-time condition no longer appears bold and its fields remain stable during the response-region split.

differences.current: The assertion request area did not explicitly reserve an independent response flex region, allowing tall assertion content to make the response area appear absent.
differences.resolution: Locked the assertion request body to a zero-minimum flex child and gave the adjacent response shell an independent 238px minimum flex basis. Browser measurements show the response shell at y=800 with 280px height and content at y=841 with 239px height at 1920x1080.
differences.followUp: Recheck response expanded/collapsed and populated result states during the remaining matrix review.
differences.decisionBasis: Make preview response panel is a persistent sibling region; direct Vue bounding-box measurement confirms it remains visible.
differences.impact: The response header and content region remain visible below every assertion editor state.
